data.narrative:
Perseus Defense operates in the Defense & Security sector alongside a fragmented peer universe of 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers, including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic. The target's stage and current valuation remain undisclosed, limiting precision in peer selection.

Peer-median methodology proved inapplicable due to insufficient narrow-stage cohort data. While 26 same-sector peers exist across Defense & Security, zero same-stage, zero adjacent-stage, and zero similar-valuation-tier matches met the minimum three-datapoint threshold required for reliable triangulation. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material bias given the heterogeneity of defense subsectors and valuation drivers across maturity stages. This constraint left no quantitative anchoring method with sufficient statistical support.

The analysis cannot produce a defensible valuation range given the absence of applicable triangulation methods and undisclosed stage data. Future revaluation depends on: (1) disclosure of Perseus's funding stage and prior rounds, enabling adjacent-stage comparables; (2) accumulation of pricing data from the identified private peer set; and (3) clarification of Perseus's specific subsector focus within Defense & Security, which would narrow the comp universe. Absent these inputs, fundamental valuation work remains premature.
